selected_priority: Bind exact outcome-calibration identity, score decomposition, and ranking rationale into each batch recruiter packet while preserving queue safety lanes and candidate-evidence boundaries.
displaced_capability: Helix could learn bounded outcome-calibrated queue weights and could compile recruiter-ready packets, but batch execution discarded the model identity and score reasoning at the packet boundary. A packet could therefore be selected by a learned model without carrying a durable explanation of which model, weights, signals, and score components produced its rank.

mechanisms_compared.assessment: Reuse the already-proven outcome calibration and batch execution systems rather than revive an older ranking surface. No historical packet provenance mechanism exceeded current main.

Mutating STRATEGY_RECEIPT.json directly could embed ranking data, but would couple recruiter-content strategy to queue learning and make deduplicated rank refreshes rewrite a receipt owned by another subsystem.

Selected: compose existing calibrate_queue into batch execution and emit a separate content-addressed PRIORITY_RECEIPT.json per selected application, allowing ranking provenance to refresh independently while preserving strategy receipts and lifecycle idempotency.
